claims.evidence: Witness photos show a blue PS4 console box with PS4 markings, but do not show the console unit or confirm it is a Slim model.

claims.claim: 10 latest games included (e.g., FIFA and PES 2027)
claims.evidence: Photos show only the PS4 box and a controller; no game discs/cases or digital library evidence is shown.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: Photos show packaging and a controller, not whether the console has been opened/repaired.
No power-on/temperature test footage is shown.
No demonstration of HDMI/USB/audio/network ports is shown.
A DualShock-style controller is shown in front of the box, but quantity and whether they are 'original pads' are not verifiable from the photos.
No receipt or document is shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Console may not be included or may be different from what the box suggests (box-only risk).
risks.proof: A clear photo/video showing the actual PS4 console powered on (logo on screen) and matching the console model/label to the box.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'box + controller only / console not confirmed', worst-case as non-working or not included.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (PS4 Slim vs other PS4 variants) and region/compatibility issues.
risks.proof: Photo of the console rear label/model number and region code (and/or serial) plus a matching box label.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest value for an unconfirmed PS4 variant.

risks.risk: Controller condition issues (stick drift, broken buttons, weak rumble).
risks.proof: Video of controller connected and tested in-game/menu showing no drift, plus a quick button/joystick calibration screen.

risks.risk: Storage capacity unknown (HDD size) and whether it’s installed/working.
risks.proof: Photo/video of the PS4 system settings screen showing storage capacity and health (or a screenshot of System Information).

risks.risk: Games claim may be false or incomplete (10 games not actually included, or wrong titles/condition).
risks.proof: Photo/video showing all game discs/cases (count = 10) or a clear list on-screen if digital (with account details handled safely).
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'no games included' or 'games unverified'.

risks.proof: Demonstration video: HDMI to TV working, USB ports recognized (e.g., controller charging/USB device), audio output working, and at least one game boot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested / may have port faults'.

risks.risk: Overheating/thermal issues not visible from packaging.
risks.proof: Short stress test clip: boot a game and show stable performance after several minutes (and/or fan noise/temperature screen if available).

risks.risk: Box condition and completeness (original packaging contents, internal inserts, manuals) may be missing despite the box being shown.
risks.proof: Photo/video of everything inside the box (manuals, cables, inserts) laid out and counted.

proof_requests: Show the actual PS4 console (not just the box) with power-on screen, and confirm it matches the box model (Slim) and region label.
Provide a video test of HDMI output and at least two USB ports (controller charging + one USB device if possible).
Show controller testing: no stick drift (menu cursor control) and button/rumble check.
Show System Information screen for storage capacity and installed status.
Show all included games physically (count and titles) or a clear on-screen list if digital.
Show the UK receipt/document and serial number/region label (or at least a photo with sensitive parts handled).
Show all included cables/accessories laid out (power cable, HDMI, controller charging cable, headset if any).
response.reason: The witness confirms only a PS4-branded blue box and a controller; the console inclusion, model variant, storage, port functionality, overheating status, and the '10 latest games' claim are not verifiable from the photos. Proof is needed to price safely.
